intent.proves: At least one live navigation paragraph (Swift-v2_Navigation, Swift-v2_OffCanvasNavigation) exists.
intent.scope: all non-deleted paragraphs on the solution

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph WHERE ParagraphItemType IN ('Swift-v2_Navigation', 'Swift-v2_OffCanvasNavigation') AND ParagraphDeleted = 0
